evidence.observation: The speaker discusses a short-term market outlook tied to geopolitical developments.
evidence.quote: the next 48 hours are going to be extremely volatile

evidence.observation: The speaker presents conditional trading scenarios for the market.
evidence.quote: that's why we have two scenarios here, both of which we're ready to trade

evidence.observation: The speaker promotes a trading channel and describes it as free while linking it to trading education and posted trades.
evidence.quote: I've created an absolutely free trading channel where I post trading education, or we post trades.

evidence.observation: The speaker directs viewers to a tutorial for using trading bots on EVEDEX.
evidence.quote: check out how to use trading bots on Evodex with this tutorial popping up on the screen

evidence.observation: The speaker links automated trading-bot use to the claim that the bots trade for viewers and perform well.
evidence.quote: as to how to use evidence trading bots that you can actually make them trade for you and they actually do quite well

evidence.observation: The speaker describes an exchange offer as providing up to thirty thousand dollars in initial deposit bonuses.
evidence.quote: they can also give you up to thirty thousand dollars in initial deposit bonuses

evidence.observation: The speaker states that the Bybit offer is conditional on signing up through the channel's link.
evidence.quote: And only if you're going to use the link of this channel, the description, this video to sign up with Bybit

evidence.quote: Trading is risky and most traders lose money.

evidence.quote: This video may include affiliate links or sponsored mentions but does not constitute an endorsement.
